page: UpCloud GPU-20xCPU-256GB-2xL40S is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for compute-intensive workloads. It features 20 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor with an x86_64 architecture, running at a base clock speed of 2.0 GHz. The CPU allocation is shared, utilizing 20 physical cores with a single thread per core. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing 12.8 GB of RAM per core. Graphics and parallel processing capabilities are delivered by two NVIDIA L40S GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, offering a combined total of 96 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local storage, meaning storage must be attached externally, and it comes with one complimentary public IPv4 address.

In benchmark evaluations, this server demonstrates top-tier single-core performance, with a stress-ng single-core score of 4182.49 and a Geekbench single-core score of 2478.0, both placing in the top 10% of tested systems. Multi-core performance is also strong, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 83933.85 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 20060.0. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching 3995.63 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 308.31 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. For language model workloads, the dual L40S GPUs and AMD EPYC processor achieve top-tier performance on small models, processing 4555.72 prompt tokens per second and generating 388.14 tokens per second on a 135M parameter model. Medium 7B model text generation remains strong at 37.36 tokens per second, though prompt processing for the same model falls into the average tier at 150.28 tokens per second.

From a resource density perspective, the server offers a high ratio of memory to CPU cores alongside dual enterprise-grade GPUs, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for workloads that require substantial VRAM and system memory without needing massive CPU core counts. The primary hardware tradeoff is the lack of bundled local storage, requiring users to provision external block storage. Given its hardware profile and benchmark strengths in image processing, text processing, and small-to-medium LLM inference, this instance is highly suited for machine learning inference, data science pipelines, 3D rendering, and memory-intensive database operations.
description: UpCloud GPU-20xCPU-256GB-2xL40S is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 20 vCPUs from an AMD EPYC 9575F processor, 256.0 GB of system memory, and two NVIDIA L40S GPUs with a total of 96 GB of VRAM. The instance does not include local storage, requiring external storage attachments. In benchmarks, the server delivers top-tier single-core CPU performance and strong multi-core capabilities, alongside high memory bandwidth. It excels in small-to-medium LLM inference, with prompt processing for a 135M model reaching 4555.72 tokens per second. This hardware profile provides a qualitatively cost-efficient balance of high-capacity VRAM and system memory relative to its CPU core count. It is well-suited for machine learning inference, image processing, data science, and memory-intensive database workloads.
